title: post_auth_v1_token_password_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password with valid email and password along with apikey header returns 200 with access_token, enabling authenticated access to protected resources.

title: get_rest_v1_orders_authorized_access
description: Verify that GET /rest/v1/orders with valid Authorization Bearer token returns only the authenticated user's orders and that no other users' orders are visible.

title: post_rest_v1_orders_insert_own_order
description: Verify that POST /rest/v1/orders with JSON body containing user_id equal to auth.uid() creates an order successfully and returns 201 with the created order representation.

title: post_rest_v1_orders_insert_foreign_userid_forbidden
description: Verify that POST /rest/v1/orders with JSON body containing another user's user_id is rejected with 403 due to RLS enforcement.

title: post_rest_v1_rpc_wallet_get_balance_own_user
description: Verify that POST /rest/v1/rpc/wallet_get_balance with JSON body containing p_user_id equal to auth.uid() and valid JWT returns 200 with wallet balance and token information for the authenticated user only.

title: get_rest_v1_bora_tokens_own_user_only
description: Verify that GET /rest/v1/bora_tokens with valid Authorization Bearer token returns only the tokens belonging to the authenticated user.

title: post_functions_v1_notify_client_authenticated
description: Verify that POST /functions/v1/notify-client with valid JWT and JSON body containing user_id, title, and body executes successfully without returning 401 unauthorized.

title: post_functions_v1_client_cancel_order_controlled_error
description: Verify that POST /functions/v1/client-cancel-order with valid JWT and JSON body containing a non-existent order_id returns a controlled 4xx error response and does not return a 500 server error.

title: get_rest_v1_ledger_entries_unauthorized_rejected
description: Verify that GET /rest/v1/ledger_entries without Authorization header returns 401 unauthorized and does not expose ledger data.

title: get_rest_v1_client_wallets_rls_enforced
description: Verify that GET /rest/v1/client_wallets with Authorization Bearer token of a different role/user returns empty or forbidden result due to RLS enforcement, preventing unauthorized wallet data access.
